description: This file contains utility functions and classes for license validation, including signature verification, license file handling, and license data extraction for the Mattermost server.

classes.name: LicenseValidatorIface
classes.description: Interface defining methods for license validation and extraction.

classes.name: LicenseValidatorImpl
classes.description: Implementation of LicenseValidatorIface for license validation logic.

methods.name: LicenseFromBytes
methods.description: Creates a License object from license bytes after validation.

methods.name: ValidateLicense
methods.description: Validates the signed license bytes by verifying the signature with the public key.

methods.name: GetAndValidateLicenseFileFromDisk
methods.description: Reads and validates a license file from disk, returning the license object.

methods.name: GetLicenseFileFromDisk
methods.description: Reads license bytes from a specified file.

methods.name: GetLicenseFileLocation
methods.description: Determines the license file location, defaulting to a config directory if not specified.

methods.name: GetClientLicense
methods.description: Extracts license data into a map of string properties for client use.

methods.name: GetSanitizedClientLicense
methods.description: Returns a sanitized copy of license properties, removing sensitive fields.
